mentions.name: Stoodious
mentions.description: Stoodious is a study guide platform for professional licensing exams. It delivers study material without gamified engagement features, and its key feature is drilling practice questions tied to the specific study section being studied (e.g., 20-30 questions on water rights, encumbrances, or GRM calculations). Material covers the basic real estate licensing exam for all 50 states, with plans to add more professional exam content.
mentions.problem: Existing study options price-gouge textbooks, offer video-only 'state-of-the-art' platforms, have no or poor mobile UX, and feel dated; finding practice questions relevant to a specific section required skimming through 100-question practice tests.
mentions.audience: Real estate exam candidates and other professional exam studiers who want straightforward study material and section-specific practice questions.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built Stoodious as a study guide platform that intends to give you the material and get out of your way, as opposed to the engagement-driving gamification of others. One of the killer features is being able to drill practice questions related to the specific study section you're working on - e.g. 20-30 questions about water rights, encumbrances or calculating GRM.
